## GFP by spot

Now that I have aligned the images, I need to extract the average GFP signal for
each spot.

This means to extract the average intensity level of GFP by shape (spot).

Let's read the data.

```{python}
import spatialdata as sd
sdata = sd.read_zarr("c26t16_final.zarr")
sdata
```


```{python}
import pandas as pd
df1 = pd.DataFrame(sdata["C26T16"])
df1
```
